title: openai: /v1/chat.completions parity - params, roles, stop/logprobs, streaming & response formatting
author: Priya Nair
description: Summary: Implement full OpenAI /v1/chat.completions parity for the compatibility layer. Motivation: customers rely on OpenAI-compatible endpoints for fast migration and ecosystem tooling; parity gaps around streaming stability, function/tool calling semantics, role handling, stop sequences, and logprobs surfaced multiple incompatibility bugs and downstream formatting regressions. This PR: 1) Adds support for full parameter mapping (temperature, top_p, n, presence_penalty, frequency_penalty, best_of) and canonicalizes legacy param aliases so third-party clients behave the same. 2) Normalizes role handling (assistant/system/user) and enforces OpenAI ordering semantics during both synchronous and streaming paths. 3) Restores stop-sequence semantics and multi-stop behavior; ensures stop is respected during streaming and after function call completions. 4) Exposes token-level logprobs in the compat response with same shape as OpenAI (choices[].logprobs.{tokens,token_logprobs,top_logprobs}) while preserving internal security filters. 5) Stabilizes streaming path: fixes race in chunk assembly that caused truncated DELTA events under high QPS and ensures function_call events stream with intermediate name/arguments tokens. 6) Response formatting: aligns choice finishing_reason values and structure for function call payloads and structured outputs. 7) Adds comprehensive unit and integration tests (openai_compat suite) and a small e2e against the eval harness. Includes docs updates in redwood-docs/openai-compat.md and a compatibility matrix entry. Rollout: feature gated behind experimental.openai_compat flag; default off for Dedicated/private until a gradual rollout completes. Related: ENG-1423, ENG-1488. Checklist: - [x] Param mapping implemented - [x] Role normalization - [x] Stop sequences in streaming - [x] Logprobs export - [x] Streaming stability fixes + tests - [x] Docs + changelog - [x] Manual smoke tested against OpenAI-cases

release_notes: OpenAI /v1/chat.completions parity: parameter mapping (temp/top_p/n/best_of), normalized roles ordering, correct stop sequence handling in streaming, token-level logprobs shape exported (feature gated), and improved streaming stability for function calls. Feature gated behind experimental.openai_compat; default off for Dedicated/Private until gradual rollout.
notes_for_ops: Gate rollout using feature flag experimental.openai_compat. Monitor streaming error rates and tail latency (serving.stream.finish_time) after enable. Watch for logprobs privacy flag experimental.logprobs_redaction and ensure KMS/HSM is used for audits if enabled. If regressions observed, rollback by toggling feature flag and reverting assembly serialization (revert commit d1f4b2a if needed).
